commit.message:
fix(diagramming-code): drop the unused pre-analysis step and name a language in examples (#365)

Step 1 told the model to build a QueryEngine and run engine.preanalysis()
"for data-flow diagrams", but the diagram command builds its own engine and
never reads pre-analysis data: call-graph, complexity and data-flow output
is byte-identical with and without it on Trailmark 0.5.0. Remove the step
(one heredoc and one extra full parse per run), and drop diagramming-code
from the core skill's "always run preanalysis before" sentence.

diagram.py defaults to --language python, so five examples without a
language parsed any repository as Python; add `-l auto`. The Quick Start
focused `main`, which fails on repositories without one; use a placeholder.
A test keeps the skill's commands consistent with this.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Co-authored-by: kz-tob <kara.zaffarano@trailofbits.com>
